memories.author: D01
memories.text: Dr Mehta's notes always follow the S/O/A/P headings, written as S:, O:, A: and P:. The Plan is a numbered list, with one action per line.

memories.author: D01
memories.text: Telmisartan is Dr Mehta's first-line antihypertensive for patients with diabetes. Other agents are added only when blood pressure stays above target on telmisartan.
